title: row23
live_proof: inspection with line numbers in the 3.22.0 tree: fts3BestSnippet() saves pHead/pTail per phrase and scores through them at fts3_snippet.c:507 and :479, while fts3EvalRestart at fts3.c:5540 frees and reloads the doclists. Fixed upstream only on trunk (a87bd2471a9c, 2026-08-17), so it is live in every release including the pin
object: the per-phrase poslist buffers held in pHead and pTail
lifetime_ender: an incremental phrase under an OR restarts the NEAR group, freeing and reloading the already-visited doclists
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator: snippet() over an OR of phrases read incrementally. Distinct from case 10 (becd68ba0d) despite the shared fts3EvalRestart site: this one dangles the snippet scorer's saved pointers, that one keeps evaluating a node whose doclist is already freed. Built in the fts3 group
